relationships.subject: oxaliplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: Oxaliplatin increased CB1 in DRG, SC, TG, Sp5C, and ventrolateral PAG, with no interference in CB2 expression.

relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: Cannabidiol increased CB1 in DRG, reduced mechanical hyperalgesia and c-Fos expression in DRG and SC.

relationships.subject: WIN 55,212-2
relationships.evidence_quote: WIN 55,212-2 increased CB1 in DRG, reduced mechanical hyperalgesia, cold allodynia and c-Fos expression in DRG and SC

relationships.subject: AM251
relationships.evidence_quote: CB1 blockage hastened the cold allodynia response
